question_text: Outline why displaying UnitPrice*Quantity in a query does not introduce stored redundancy, while saving the same total as an independently editable table field could do so.
adaptation_rationale: Use dependency/redundancy reasoning without implying every derived field is exempt from normalization. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: A query calculates the value from current inputs without storing another independent copy. A stored total duplicates a fact determined by price and quantity and could become inconsistent after updates.

marking_points.criterion: Query computes rather than stores another independent fact.
Stored independently editable total may disagree with determinant fields.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.
